inputs.name: jevMetrics.events
inputs.description: An array of analytics event records from which JEV checks are selected. Checks and outcome counts include records with kind === "jev" and checkType === type; task summaries additionally require an identity (task or both loop and step), an uncached record, and an assessed status, and skip duplicate fingerprints or IDs.

inputs.name: jevMetrics.type
inputs.description: The string used for an exact match against event.checkType. Only jev events with this value are included in the check set.

inputs.name: jevMetrics.author
inputs.description: When present, this filters by exact event.agentModel equality, treating a missing agent model as "unknown". It applies to check counts, outcome counts, exclusions, and task summaries.

inputs.name: jevMetrics.model
inputs.description: When present and truthy, this keeps checks whose agentModel or evaluatorModel equals the model string. An omitted or empty string disables this filter.

outputs.name: jevMetrics
outputs.type: { checks: number; outcomes: Record<string, number>; excluded: number; firstTry: { numerator: number; denominator: number; rate: number | null; }; tasks: { project: string; loop: string | undefined; step: string | undefined; task: string | undefined; agentModel: string; attempts: number; attemptsToPass: number | null; firstPassed: boolean; report: string | undefined; }[]; }
outputs.description: The result contains matching check and status counts, the excluded-record count, first-try pass totals and rate, and summaries of eligible task groups. The first-try rate is null when there are no task groups; groups use project, loopRun, task identity, and check type, and each summary carries the first attempt’s report value.
